name: Starter Battle
description: The Starter game's battles: three rivals and unowned creatures in 1 vs 1 and 2 vs 2, recruiting, healing, the storage boxes and the AI playing both sides.

editor.notes: D-40 RP: this app as a sample project. The Studio's Open a sample... (capsule-studio sample copy) copies the app folder (less this file) into a new folder and the Starter sample's files (its template.json) into data/starter, and points the copy's manifests at them, so the copy builds as a game of its own (docs/APPS.md, Sample projects).
